notes.text: Cause: the clustering at each commit (ADR 0016) changes the parent of files; changed_files counted them. Fixed in tracking::changed_files (regrouped); tests files_only_regrouped_into_another_component_are_not_changed and work_committed_after_its_session_ended_holds_no_agent.

tasks.criterion: timonier test on Timonier gives a timeline per test with spans attached to graph nodes; a provoked regression is detected; an exceeded budget shows in red (PLAN.md, Q71)

tasks.title: 9.8 Optimiser la consommation de ressources du daemon (CPU idle, RSS, I/O sqlite, croissance du cache) : baseline mesurée, optimisations minimales, re-mesure
tasks.criterion: Le daemon consomme moins en régime permanent et au démarrage qu'avant, tests et clippy passent, aucune régression fonctionnelle

notes.text: Measured on this repository (release, fresh database): threads 71 → 19, peak RSS 116 → 80 MB, cold indexing CPU 2.4 → 1.47 s, wall 0.44 → 0.49 s, rest unchanged (10 ms per 20 s), saves p95 14.9 ms. Found and fixed: the home folder taken for a project (a daemon indexing all of ~ at 1.3 cores, 71 s to stop); ~ and / are never a project now, and a whole indexing gives up at shutdown. 580 Rust tests, clippy clean.
